stories.subject: Grand Theft Auto VI $3.79B day-one retail record
stories.verification: AP reported Rockstar's company-estimated worldwide day-one figure and 32.5M pre-release units; Take-Two's Nov. 20 8-K release gives the $3.79B record and identifies the estimate as based on Nov. 19 worldwide retail sales.

stories.subject: Rockstar's GTA VI Nov. 23 launch update
stories.verification: Rockstar Support lists the Nov. 23 fixes for crashes, weather, autosaves, phone calls, Wanted Levels and other bugs; TechRadar independently summarized the first update and highlighted the mission-blocking and autosave fixes.

stories.subject: Texas rap streaming growth and Mike Jones' GTA VI revival
stories.verification: Axios reported Spotify's 125% five-year U.S. Texas-rap streaming increase and 60% Houston growth; the Houston Chronicle reported Mike Jones' GTA VI radio placements and the reported post-launch resurgence while clearly attributing the 700% figure to WorldStar.

stories.subject: The Tupac Tapes with Angie Martinez premieres Nov. 27
stories.verification: Netflix Tudum announced the four-part Nov. 27 event and described the previously unreleased portions of Martinez's 1996 interview; Vice independently reported the Netflix release and the three-decade delay.

stories.subject: Denzel Curry voices DWNPLY in GTA VI
stories.verification: Rockstar's official credits list Denzel Curry as DWNPLY and credit three DWNPLY songs; AP independently reported Curry among the names revealed in Rockstar's sprawling cast list.

dedupe_note: Compared against the Nov. 23 morning and evening batches plus the full automation memory; excluded prior GTA VI sales, Grammy-field, GTA VI hotfix and Mike Jones-only carousel topics where the new angle would duplicate a recent item.
